review_highlights.comment: It's been almost a year since I took Cindy's class and I am so glad I got her early on because not many people know how to teach writing. I had some bad profs since her, so now I can say I appreciate her more now then I did back then. At the time I thought she was giving us too much to do and being too picky; now I know why that was so important.

She's tough. The class started out easy and then became harder. Just when I thought I was getting the hang of it, Cindy (she lets her call her by her first name) pushed us to do more. We created cool news blogs and I'm proud of the work I did in the class. Looking back, I'm really glad I took her section. So much better than the other ones.

Had her for Inquiry. She takes some getting used to, since she doesn't really stick to the syllabus, but she's a really nice person. Brought us pizza because she was happy with our rewrites. She's interested in our progress and wants to see us succeed. I like her way of giving us three big stories, instead of one every week.

This was a tough class. Lots of writing and rewriting. I thought I was a good writer and came to realize I have a lot to learn about journalistic writing. But I feel I learned a lot in this class. She made us create blogs and I am happy with the way mine came out. I have a nice portfolio now, which I will build on.

Professor Rodriguez really worked us hard. Lots of rewriting of our stories, but the assignments were fun and just like she predicted my writing improved 100 percent. She's not like other professors who haven't been in a newsroom in years. She has a ton of experience and it shows in the way she conducts the class.
